Leo — Soft Materials, Skin Mechanics and Fabrication said about it: The A Complete Guide to Silicone Product Design (E10) gives uniform walls typically 0.5 to 3 mm and 1.5 to 3 mm silicone over rigid backing for soft grips, and the Percentile values of hand dimensions (mm) in right and left hands.
Maya — Tactile Transduction and Sensing Physics said about it: The A Complete Guide to Silicone Product Design (E10) gives uniform walls typically 0.5 to 3 mm, so 1.5 mm skin from your hemispherical cap sketch (E17) keeps 2.5 mm taxels distinct at thimble scale, while static force at 25 Hz plus vibration at 2 kHz from the data rate check (E23) keeps slip buzz alive.
Leo — Soft Materials, Skin Mechanics and Fabrication said about it: The A Complete Guide to Silicone Product Design (E10) allows uniform walls 0.5 to 3 mm, so 1.5 mm skin plus 1.0 mm pillars from the hemispherical cap sketch (E17) fit a 15 to 20 mm diameter cap at thimble scale in LSR, where LSR means liquid silicone rubber.
Maya — Tactile Transduction and Sensing Physics said about it: The A Complete Guide to Silicone Product Design (E10) allows uniform walls 0.5 mm to 3 mm, so 1.5 mm skin from the hemispherical cap sketch (E17) keeps 2.5 mm pitch distinct at thimble scale.
